text: Lasal Saha Clinic is my first chiropractic experience in Chiang Mai. The doctors are helpful and do their best to make you feel better. I had deep tissue massage, cupping and chiropractic adjustment.

Whenever I return to Thailand, I always come to Lasalle Clinic. I usually get massages at the Bangkok branch, but now they have a branch in Chiang Mai, which is even more convenient. They offer chiropractic treatment, cupping, and massage therapy. The place is clean and easy to get to. The doctors are all very attentive and lovely. Thank you very much! ☺️
I've tried cupping therapy and chiropractic adjustments before, and I have to say it was great. The staff were very friendly, and I felt relaxed and my aches and pains disappeared.
The doctor was very gentle and professional; it was a great experience!
